nodes.text: to warm the coals with handfuls of tow
and to seek the seed of fire amid the waters.
When this was reported to the judge, swelling with rage,
it stirred the anger of his implacable gall:
'How long, pray, will this supreme magician
make sport of us,' he said, 'with a Thessalian charm,
skilled at turning punishment into a joke?
Perhaps his neck, if I order it, to be severed,
to bend beneath the sword, will not lie open to the wound;
so that the raw hearts of men, once refined, might come to know
either the work of fear or the mystic and deep things of Christ.
There was one among the young men most learned in sinister arts,
in breaking down chastity by fraud, in holding nothing sacred,
often, too, in working a magic incantation among the tombs,
by which he might undo the lawful bond of the marriage-bed, the bride inflamed with passion.
The madness of such great lust Christ suddenly restrains;
he shakes the darkness from his breast and drives out the frenzy,
fills him with love of himself, grants him to believe, grants him to be ashamed of what he had done,
and now the look of his face and his elegance is other than it was:
